nodes.label: Vite Logo SVG (unused starter asset)
nodes.description: Official Vite brand logo (77x47 viewBox): a purple (#9135ff) lightning-bolt shape filled with blurred purple/lavender/cyan gradient ellipses via a mask, framed by a pair of curved parenthesis strokes that switch from black to white under prefers-color-scheme: dark. Has an accessible <title>Vite</title>.
nodes.rationale: Leftover from the Vite + React starter template. No file under apps/web/src imports vite.svg (grep for vite.svg, viteLogo and ./assets returned nothing), so it is an unused asset and a candidate for removal; Boxy uses its own PWA icons in apps/web/public/icon-*.png for branding.
